notes.title: Local Coop Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=DgG6ZJtUmKo;full][/previewyoutube]

We've spent the past few months working hard on improving Detective Bot. Along with the local coop update we've done a huge overhaul of underlying systems which has resulted in all the known major bugs being fixed and the vast majority of known minor bugs being fixed!

With this update you'll now be able to play with up to three of your friends to control Detective Bot and solve some tricky cases!

notes.title: Patch Notes 30/05/2020
notes.content: Fixed major crashes at the end of the game and throughout play. Hopefully this should mean that the game is stable and free from any game breaking bugs.
